data.title: D · 玄关送别时的整理领带
data.description: 玄关落满晨光，D踮起脚尖双手细致地为你抚平西装领带。她仰起清冷娇俏的面容，深紫色眼眸认真地注视着你，轻声叮嘱你今晚一定要早点平安回家。
data.location: sunlit entrance hallway of the cozy safehouse
data.action: standing close at front door, gently fixing partner necktie with delicate hands, looking up into his eyes with serious yet deeply loving gaze
data.lighting: soft directional entrance light highlighting sharp features and red hairpin
data.mood: loving newlywed departure, earnest devotion, sweet domestic vow
data.promptProse: Fixing partner necktie gently at the entrance door, D looks up with deep purple eyes and a serious yet tender loving expression.
data.animaCaption: D adjusting partner necktie at the door with a loving newlywed gaze.
